rounding.summary: Molecular Betrayal and the generic stat-gain event path add UNROUNDED doubles to the stored stat fields. Rounding happens (1) once when the stored stats are built (fusion floor, ceil after level, ceil after sigil/godforge), (2) per effect where its own code floors a share, and (3) at every in-battle read of Attack/Defense/Intelligence/Speed (floor). Health is never floored by its getters.

app_formula.molecular_betrayal: for f in [hp, hpmax, attack, intelligence, defense, speed]: gain_f = (third_creature_stored_f * 0.01) * rank (no rounding); Animatus stored_f += gain_f. stored_f = the out-of-battle stat (stored_stat_final_step), NOT the artifact/relic/trait-boosted value.
app_formula.battle_stat: Attack/Defense/Intelligence/Speed in battle = floor(stored + gains + sum(pct_i * running stored)) - the Molecular Betrayal gain is inside 'stored', so the Animatus's own % bonuses multiply it before the single floor.
app_formula.health: max Health = stored hpmax + Molecular Betrayal gain (unrounded) + relic bonus (unrounded, % of current hpmax) + floor(hpmax_so_far * artifact% / 100); never floored as a whole.
app_formula.stored_stat: g = (fused ? floor((A + B) / 2) : A) + scrolls + flat adds; S = ceil(g * (1 + r * (level - 1))); stored = max(1, ceil(max(0, S * (1 +/- sigil% + godforge%))))
